definitions.explanation: A local branch of the National Tax Agency that handles income tax returns, tax audits, and other tax-related matters. There are over 500 tax offices across Japan.

examples.japanese: {税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To file a tax return at the tax office.

examples.japanese: {税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A notice arrived from the tax office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{二月|にがつ}→二月：00657_nigatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧、{税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{混雑|こんざつ}する→混雑する：25387_konzatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Every year from February to March, tax offices are crowded with people seeking help with their tax returns.

notes:
USAGE:
{税務署|ぜいむしょ} is the local branch where individuals and small businesses interact with the tax system. It is distinct from the {国税庁|こくぜいちょう} (National Tax Agency), which is the central authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}る→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧: to file/report to the tax office
- {税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult the tax office
- {税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: tax office counter
- {税務署|ぜいむしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: tax office audit

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the tax filing season (⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧) runs from February 16 to March 15 each year. Many people visit their local {税務署|ぜいむしょ} in person, though online filing (e-Tax) is increasingly common.
